title: cdk-construct-step-functions examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-step-functions/examples/.

Scenarios:
- standard/ — type STANDARD, simple Pass state definition
- express/ — type EXPRESS (divergent: different execution model, logging required)
- with-logging/ — loggingConfiguration enabled, log group from new or existing ARN
- with-tracing/ — tracingEnabled:true (divergent: adds X-Ray)
- with-policies/ — policyDocuments, managedPolicyArns

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in test/step-functions-examples.test.ts.
